title: Genomic DNA Extraction from Asterionella formosa for Next Generation Sequencing
author: Carine Puppo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jytcpwn
materials: Prepare the following solutions: 1 M Tris-HCl at pH 8.0. 0.5 M EDTA at pH 8.0. 5 M NaCl. 7.5 M Ammonium acetate.
Carefully discard the supernatant without touching the pellet.
Discard the supernatant (without touching the pellet).
Test the DNA with a PCR reaction

steps.title: Prepare 10% CTAB solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve CTAB powder in molecular‑grade water, microwave until fully dissolved, then store at 37 °C to prevent precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Add CTAB powder slowly to water.
Microwave until completely dissolved.
Keep the solution at 37 °C.

steps.title: Preheat water baths
steps.instruction: Set one water bath to 65 °C and a second bath to 37 °C.

steps.title: Make CTAB extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 3 ml 10 % CTAB, 2.8 ml 5 M NaCl, 0.4 ml 5 M EDTA, 1 ml Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 2.78 ml molecular‑grade water, and 0.02 ml β‑mercaptoethanol; handle β‑mercaptoethanol in a fume hood, keep the buffer on ice, then pre‑heat to 65 °C.

substeps.instruction: Mix the listed reagents to obtain final concentrations of 3 % CTAB, 28 % NaCl, 4 % EDTA, and 10 % Tris‑HCl.
Add β‑mercaptoethanol (0.02 ml) under a fume hood.
Pre‑heat the completed buffer to 65 °C.

steps.title: Store precipitation reagents
steps.instruction: Keep 100 % isopropanol at –20 °C and 7.5 M ammonium acetate at 4 °C until needed.

steps.title: Harvest and lyse cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 250 ml Asterionella formosa culture (OD ≈ 0.1) to collect ~90 mg cells, resuspend the pellet in 1.5 ml pre‑heated CTAB buffer, and incubate at 65 °C for 1 hour (longer if required).

steps.title: Collect lysate and aliquot
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge to gather liquid adhering to tube walls, then divide the lysate into three 500 µl aliquots in DNase/RNase‑free 1.5 ml tubes.

steps.title: First chloroform‑isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: To each aliquot add 500 µl chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1), invert for 5 min, centrifuge 10 min at 11 000 × g at room temperature, and transfer 500 µl of the upper aqueous phase to a fresh tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µl chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1).
Mix by inversion for 5 min.
Centrifuge 10 min at 11 000 × g, RT.
Pipette 500 µl upper aqueous phase into a new tube.

steps.title: RNase treatment and second extraction
steps.instruction: Add 8 µl RNase (4 mg/ml) to each aqueous phase, mix by pipetting, split each tube into two 250 µl portions, add 500 µl chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to each portion, briefly invert, then recombine portions to a total volume of 500 µl.

substeps.instruction: Add 8 µl RNase (4 mg/ml) and mix thoroughly.
Split each tube into two 250 µl aliquots.
Add 500 µl chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to each aliquot.
Invert briefly to mix.
Combine the aliquots back to a final volume of 500 µl.

steps.title: Combine aqueous phases
steps.instruction: Using a syringe, transfer the aqueous phase(s) into 1.5 ml tubes, combine samples without exceeding 750 µl per tube, and record the total volume.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of cold (‑20 °C) 100 % isopropanol and add 8 % (v/v) of the measured volume of cold 7.5 M ammonium acetate, invert to mix, then incubate in a freezer for 30 min–1 h.

substeps.instruction: Add cold isopropanol equal to the measured aqueous volume.
Add cold 7.5 M ammonium acetate equal to 8 % of that volume.
Mix thoroughly by inversion.
Incubate at –20 °C for 30 min to 1 h.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 10 min at 11 000 × g at 4 °C, discard the supernatant, and retain the pellet.

steps.title: Ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Add 700 µl 70 % ethanol without resuspending, centrifuge 3 min at 11 000 × g RT, discard supernatant; then add 700 µl 100 % ethanol, invert 5–10 times, centrifuge 3 min at 11 000 × g RT, and discard supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µl 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 3 min at 11 000 × g RT, discard supernatant.
Add 700 µl 100 % ethanol, invert 5–10 times, centrifuge 3 min at 11 000 × g RT, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Dry and rehydrate DNA
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the pellet briefly in a chemical flow hood, then add 30–50 µl molecular‑grade water (volume based on pellet size) to rehydrate.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA next day
steps.instruction: On the following day, pipette up and down to fully dissolve the DNA.

steps.title: Quantify and assess DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with a Nanodrop (or similar) and run a 1 % agarose gel at 100 V for 20 min.
